headline: ANVIL separates LLM formulation from deterministic optimization-code compilation
summary: The authors introduce ANVIL, which uses an LLM once to formulate an LP/MILP in LaTeX and then compiles that representation through a typed, deterministic pipeline into PuLP code. On 354 easy and hard NLP4LP benchmark problems, the paper reports deterministic compilation for 329 (92.9%) with no model-code fallback; among 320 problems with numeric references, 299 matched (93.4%). These are author-reported results from one arXiv preprint, not an independent reproduction.
